decisions.decision: The Board agreed the appointment-process timing suggestions in the Executive Assistant's memo were acceptable.
decisions.quote: the board had no issues with ms. peterson's suggestions.

decisions.decision: The appointment process question (reappointment form, ad hoc vs. standing committees) was deferred to a future meeting for lack of consensus.
decisions.quote: since there was lack of consensus on the process since the board began working on this goal, it will be discussed at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: The Chair will work with the Town Manager on the order of the Annual Town Meeting articles.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo will work with ms. lemieux on the order of them.

decisions.decision: The Board will not meet on March 23 and will meet on March 30, when it would finalize the warrant.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo noted this board is not meeting on the 23d but will be meeting on march 30th.

budget_items.quote: they can update the existing conditions plan for us for $750.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $25,000 state earmark for the Primary School Fire Alarm Upgrade must be spent by June 30, 2021, unless the legislature extends it; the School Facilities Director said the project cannot proceed without funding for its full $127,000 cost.
budget_items.quote: the $25,000 earmark we received for the primary school fire alarm upgrade

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW Director is securing quotes for a full landscape design; funding will be requested at Annual Town Meeting with a recommendation to take it from Free Cash. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the dpw director is also securing quotes for a full landscape design of the old primary school property.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article O would create a Health Insurance Stabilization Fund and fund it with $369,334.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux reported the amount would be $369,334.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article DD's longevity bonus for employees hired after June 30, 2021 is set at $1,280 (department heads) and $850 (other positions) at 10 years, rising to $1,920 and $3,200 at 15 and 20 years. Employees hired before June 30, 2021 receive percentages of salary (2%, 2.5%, 3%) instead.
budget_items.quote: annual bonus equal to $1,280 payable in the first pay period after the employee's anniversary date. at 15 years of continuous service-$1,920 and at 20 years of continuous service-$3,200.
